about: Party of each sitting NYC Council Member: every ballot line they won on (#28, layer 4). Curated by BetaNYC from NYC Board of Elections certified results; not an official record of party membership.
scope: The 51 people holding a Council seat on 2026-11-12. Joined on Legistar person_id.
method: Lines and votes copied from the 'Total for' rows of the Board of Elections 'Statement and Return Report for Certification' for the election that gave the member their seat (2025-11-04 general, certified 2025-12-02; District 3: 2026-04-28 special). NYC has fusion voting: every line is listed. Write-ins are not lines. total_votes is the sum of the member's lines. Lines are printed exactly as the Board prints them. All 50 general-election rows were re-checked by script against the Board's CSVs on 2026-11-12: 0 differences.

rows.name: Carl Wilson
rows.source_title: Board of Elections in the City of New York, 2026 Special Election, Official Ranked Choice Rounds, Council Member 3rd Council District (certified May 12, 2026)
rows.notes: Special-election independent line, not a party. Votes are certified (BOE RCV report): 6,279 first-round votes; 7,885 in the final round (4 rounds) vs. Lindsey Boylan 5,391. The certified RCV report does not print ballot lines; the line name 'For All of Us' is from BOE's own pre-election contest list (https://vote.nyc/sites/default/files/pdf/candidates/2026/Contest%20List_April%2028%202026_Special%20Election.pdf, 'The Contest List, Special Election 3rd Council District - 04/28/2026', printed 3/13/2026, marked 'Tentative, subject to change'), consistent with Ballotpedia. Status 'likely' because the line is not on the certified document. total_votes is first-round (one line). Caution: Wilson also won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for this seat, so the 2026-11-03 general election may change his lines; that result was not checked here. Wilson also won the 2026-06-23 Democratic primary for this seat, so the 2026-11-03 general election may have given him new lines; on 2026-11-12 the Board had posted no 2026 general results. Re-check when they are certified.

second_check.result: line confirmed on the Board's contest list; win confirmed on the certified ranked-choice report
second_check.evidence: The Board's contest list (printed 2026-03-13, marked tentative) shows Carl Wilson on 'For All of Us'; the certified report shows him elected in round 4 with 7,885 votes. The line itself is not on a certified document, so the row stays 'likely' and certified is false.
